name: Four qubits on a line
description: An end-to-end CX and a disjoint middle CX, followed by several competing interactions.

name: Four qubits on a star
description: Leaf-to-leaf CX gates test how a degree-three hub is used; the physical hub is P1.

name: Six qubits with a degree-four hub
description: Hub qubit 2 (picture node 3) connects to 0, 1, 3, and 5. Qubit 1 also connects to 3, and 3 connects to 4.

name: Six qubits with a degree-five hub
description: Leaves 1 and 3 only touch the hub. They alternate with CX gates on the far side, so the two routers insert different numbers of SWAPs.
